acceptanceCriteria: A build-log entry retains the STR-V0-013 parity report for `corvint test` against both earlier drivers. Every difference is explained or fixed.
20 PRs merge through the queue on the `corvint test` CI call site with complete forward rows and no AFP-V0-030 trip. This is counted under the epoch that V1-0040 advanced.
A build-log entry records median and p90 PR wall time and runner-minutes per merged PR, before and after the switch. Unavailable hosted measurements stay `NOT_OBSERVED`.

Session Test Runner V0 delivery moves from experimental to delivered in the spec header, docs/specs/README.md and docs/specs/INDEX.json, citing that evidence. If a kill criterion fires instead, the evidence and the rollback are recorded.

Balanced placement is decided separately. It is promoted locally only with at least a 20% lower p90 slowest-shard wall time against universe placement over the same frozen pairs and shard count. In CI it is promoted only after an accepted AFP-V0-028 amendment and an executed p90 comparison over 20 PRs. Otherwise it is recorded as unpromoted or removed.
body: Follow-up to V1-0040. This covers the Session Test Runner V0 promotion bar in docs/specs/session-test-runner-v0.md (Acceptance evidence: promotion and kill criteria). V1-0040 closes when the spec, slices 1 to 3 and the call-site switch merge; it leaves `corvint test` experimental. This ticket collects the post-switch evidence that promotion needs, and applies the kill criteria if they fire: an unexplained parity difference that cannot be fixed, or a queue MISS caused by the runner rather than the selector. Computed placement estimates never count as observed timing. Owner priority on 2026-10-11: work on this as soon as possible.
title: test runner: promote `corvint test` from experimental on its STR-V0 promotion evidence (V1-0040 follow-up)
